data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.name: qmd
data_tooling.summary: QMD是一款本地命令行搜索工具，专为个人文档、知识库和会议笔记提供快速、私密的检索服务。它采用前沿的嵌入和索引技术，在离线环境下高效处理文本数据，避免了云服务的依赖和隐私风险。用户可通过索引Markdown文件或连接笔记应用，将其集成到日常工作流中，实现安全、即时的信息查找，特别适合开发者、研究人员和知识工作者管理分散的文档资源。
data_tooling.summary_en: QMD is a local CLI search engine that enables fast, private document retrieval without cloud dependencies. It implements state-of-the-art embedding and indexing techniques to efficiently search personal knowledge bases, meeting notes, and documentation offline. Users can integrate it into their workflow by indexing markdown files or connecting it to note-taking apps for instant, secure information access across their digital workspace.

edge_embedded.name: immich
edge_embedded.summary: Immich 是一款高性能的自托管照片视频管理平台，解决了用户依赖谷歌相册等云服务的厂商锁定问题，让您完全掌控个人媒体库。它采用 TypeScript/Node.js 后端配合 Flutter 移动应用的技术架构，通过高效的媒体处理和跨设备同步机制，实现流畅的浏览和管理体验。您可以通过 Docker 在自有服务器上部署，使用移动应用自动备份照片，随时随地访问完整媒体库，享受完全私有的照片管理方案，非常适合注重数据隐私和想要摆脱云服务限制的用户实践自托管解决方案。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Immich is a self-hosted photo and video management platform that solves the problem of vendor lock-in with cloud services like Google Photos by giving users complete control over their media library. It achieves high performance through a modern TypeScript/Node.js backend with Flutter mobile apps, enabling efficient media processing and smooth cross-device synchronization. You can deploy it on your own server using Docker, then use the mobile app to automatically backup photos while accessing your entire collection from any device with full privacy and no subscription fees.

ui_devex.name: llama.cpp
ui_devex.summary: Llama.cpp 是一个用 C/C++ 实现的开源项目，专门解决在普通硬件上高效运行大语言模型的难题，让用户无需依赖昂贵的云端计算资源。它通过 GGML 量化技术和优化的 CPU 计算实现高性能推理，展示了如何通过精细的内存管理让数十亿参数模型在本地设备上流畅运行。开发者可以将其集成到桌面应用中，构建本地 AI 助手，或利用其简洁的 C/C++ API 进行自定义模型部署实验，非常适合需要实时文本生成的实际场景。
ui_devex.summary_en: Llama.cpp is an open-source C/C++ implementation that enables efficient large language model inference on consumer hardware, solving the challenge of running sophisticated AI without expensive cloud infrastructure. It achieves remarkable performance through GGML's quantization techniques and optimized CPU computation, demonstrating how careful memory management can make billion-parameter models accessible. Developers can integrate it into desktop applications, build local AI assistants, or experiment with custom model deployments using its straightforward C/C++ API for real-time text generation tasks.

ui_devex.name: goose
ui_devex.summary: Goose是一个开源AI智能体框架，它超越了传统的代码建议功能，能够处理完整的软件开发工作流程。其核心技术在于采用模型上下文协议（MCP）构建模块化、可扩展的智能体，这些智能体可以自主安装依赖、执行代码、编辑文件和运行测试。基于Rust的架构允许开发者连接任何大语言模型，创建定制化智能体用于自动化测试、代码重构或持续集成等场景，为AI辅助开发提供了更实用、可扩展的解决方案。
ui_devex.summary_en: Goose is an open-source AI agent framework that extends beyond basic code suggestions to handle full software development workflows. Its technical innovation lies in using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create modular, extensible agents that can install dependencies, execute code, edit files, and run tests autonomously. Developers can integrate Goose with any LLM through its Rust-based architecture to build custom agents for tasks like automated testing, code refactoring, or continuous integration pipelines, making AI-assisted development more practical and scalable.

ui_devex.name: Telegram-iOS
ui_devex.summary: Telegram-iOS 是 Telegram 官方开源的 iOS 客户端，专注于提供安全、功能丰富的即时通讯体验。它采用 Swift 语言开发，通过现代化的并发模型和优化的网络层实现高效实时通信，支持大规模群组和媒体传输而不影响性能。开发者可以借鉴其架构设计构建可扩展的聊天应用，利用 SwiftUI 组件自定义界面，或学习其加密协议增强自身项目的隐私保护能力，适合用于研究高性能移动通讯应用的实现方案。
ui_devex.summary_en: Telegram-iOS is the official open-source iOS client for Telegram, providing a secure and feature-rich messaging experience. It showcases efficient real-time communication through Swift's modern concurrency model and optimized network layers, ensuring smooth performance even with large groups and media. Developers can study its architecture for building scalable chat apps, customize the UI with SwiftUI components, or integrate its encryption protocols into their own projects for enhanced privacy.

ui_devex.name: personaplex
ui_devex.summary: PersonaPlex是一个开源框架，用于在单一系统中创建和管理多个AI角色，以解决传统对话代理缺乏上下文感知和角色多样性的问题。它采用模块化架构，通过动态选择和组合不同角色模块来响应对话情境，使单个模型能够展现多变的语气、专业知识和行为特征。其核心在于将角色定义为可插拔的组件，开发者可以用Python自定义角色，并通过API集成，从而构建需要灵活AI角色的应用，如交互式叙事、拥有不同专家声音的客服机器人，或多智能体系统研究，为探索
ui_devex.summary_en: PersonaPlex is an open-source framework for creating and managing multiple AI personas within a single system, addressing the need for more nuanced and context-aware conversational agents. It employs a modular architecture where distinct persona modules can be dynamically selected and combined based on conversation context, enabling a single model to exhibit varied tones, expertise, and behavioral traits. Developers can use it to build applications requiring adaptable AI characters, such as interactive storytelling, customer service bots with different specialist voices, or research into multi-agent systems, by defining custom personas in Python and integrating them via the provided API.

deployment_serving.name: llama.cpp
deployment_serving.summary: Llama.cpp 是一个用 C/C++ 实现的开源项目，专门解决在普通硬件上高效运行大语言模型的难题，让用户无需依赖昂贵的云端计算资源。它通过 GGML 量化技术和优化的 CPU 计算实现高性能推理，展示了如何通过精细的内存管理让数十亿参数模型在本地设备上流畅运行。开发者可以将其集成到桌面应用中，构建本地 AI 助手，或利用其简洁的 C/C++ API 进行自定义模型部署实验，非常适合需要实时文本生成的实际场景。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Llama.cpp is an open-source C/C++ implementation that enables efficient large language model inference on consumer hardware, solving the challenge of running sophisticated AI without expensive cloud infrastructure. It achieves remarkable performance through GGML's quantization techniques and optimized CPU computation, demonstrating how careful memory management can make billion-parameter models accessible. Developers can integrate it into desktop applications, build local AI assistants, or experiment with custom model deployments using its straightforward C/C++ API for real-time text generation tasks.

deployment_serving.name: immich
deployment_serving.summary: Immich 是一款高性能的自托管照片视频管理平台，解决了用户依赖谷歌相册等云服务的厂商锁定问题，让您完全掌控个人媒体库。它采用 TypeScript/Node.js 后端配合 Flutter 移动应用的技术架构，通过高效的媒体处理和跨设备同步机制，实现流畅的浏览和管理体验。您可以通过 Docker 在自有服务器上部署，使用移动应用自动备份照片，随时随地访问完整媒体库，享受完全私有的照片管理方案，非常适合注重数据隐私和想要摆脱云服务限制的用户实践自托管解决方案。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Immich is a self-hosted photo and video management platform that solves the problem of vendor lock-in with cloud services like Google Photos by giving users complete control over their media library. It achieves high performance through a modern TypeScript/Node.js backend with Flutter mobile apps, enabling efficient media processing and smooth cross-device synchronization. You can deploy it on your own server using Docker, then use the mobile app to automatically backup photos while accessing your entire collection from any device with full privacy and no subscription fees.

framework_core.name: personaplex
framework_core.summary: PersonaPlex是一个开源框架，用于在单一系统中创建和管理多个AI角色，以解决传统对话代理缺乏上下文感知和角色多样性的问题。它采用模块化架构，通过动态选择和组合不同角色模块来响应对话情境，使单个模型能够展现多变的语气、专业知识和行为特征。其核心在于将角色定义为可插拔的组件，开发者可以用Python自定义角色，并通过API集成，从而构建需要灵活AI角色的应用，如交互式叙事、拥有不同专家声音的客服机器人，或多智能体系统研究，为探索
framework_core.summary_en: PersonaPlex is an open-source framework for creating and managing multiple AI personas within a single system, addressing the need for more nuanced and context-aware conversational agents. It employs a modular architecture where distinct persona modules can be dynamically selected and combined based on conversation context, enabling a single model to exhibit varied tones, expertise, and behavioral traits. Developers can use it to build applications requiring adaptable AI characters, such as interactive storytelling, customer service bots with different specialist voices, or research into multi-agent systems, by defining custom personas in Python and integrating them via the provided API.

agents_workflows.name: qmd
agents_workflows.summary: QMD是一款本地命令行搜索工具，专为个人文档、知识库和会议笔记提供快速、私密的检索服务。它采用前沿的嵌入和索引技术，在离线环境下高效处理文本数据，避免了云服务的依赖和隐私风险。用户可通过索引Markdown文件或连接笔记应用，将其集成到日常工作流中，实现安全、即时的信息查找，特别适合开发者、研究人员和知识工作者管理分散的文档资源。
agents_workflows.summary_en: QMD is a local CLI search engine that enables fast, private document retrieval without cloud dependencies. It implements state-of-the-art embedding and indexing techniques to efficiently search personal knowledge bases, meeting notes, and documentation offline. Users can integrate it into their workflow by indexing markdown files or connecting it to note-taking apps for instant, secure information access across their digital workspace.

security_safety.name: Telegram-iOS
security_safety.summary: Telegram-iOS 是 Telegram 官方开源的 iOS 客户端，专注于提供安全、功能丰富的即时通讯体验。它采用 Swift 语言开发，通过现代化的并发模型和优化的网络层实现高效实时通信，支持大规模群组和媒体传输而不影响性能。开发者可以借鉴其架构设计构建可扩展的聊天应用，利用 SwiftUI 组件自定义界面，或学习其加密协议增强自身项目的隐私保护能力，适合用于研究高性能移动通讯应用的实现方案。
security_safety.summary_en: Telegram-iOS is the official open-source iOS client for Telegram, providing a secure and feature-rich messaging experience. It showcases efficient real-time communication through Swift's modern concurrency model and optimized network layers, ensuring smooth performance even with large groups and media. Developers can study its architecture for building scalable chat apps, customize the UI with SwiftUI components, or integrate its encryption protocols into their own projects for enhanced privacy.
